about.preview: Hello, I’m Thomas, a full-stack software engineer with over 10 years of experience in tech. I specialize in React, TypeScript, Laravel, and MySQL, and hold an M.S in Information Technology with a focus on Enterprise Software Development.
more: My interest in technology began when I was 11 years old. I learned to assemble and disassemble desktop computers, install operating systems, and troubleshoot hardware and software issues. At 13, I discovered programming by experimenting with open-source Visual Basic 6 projects stored on a CD.

Fast-forward to today, I create SaaS applications and help clients and businesses transform their ideas into reliable, scalable, and user-friendly software. I enjoy solving complex problems, improving inefficient processes, and building practical solutions that deliver lasting value.
